# sherpa-container-header

The header bar for a container's `header` slot.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Container Header |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-container-header/sherpa-container-header.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-container-header/sherpa-container-header.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-container-header/sherpa-container-header.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-container-header/sherpa-container-header.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-container-header/sherpa-container-header.example.json) |

## When to use it

For the header row in a `sherpa-container`'s `header` slot: a heading, an icon, actions, and optional collapse, close and drag buttons that fire events. `sherpa-dialog` and `sherpa-panel` draw their own from `data-heading`; for a card that opens and shuts by itself, use `sherpa-accordion`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-container-header data-heading="Overview" data-description="This quarter" data-collapsible data-dismissible></sherpa-container-header>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-collapsed` | boolean | `false` | collapsed state (opt-in; absent = expanded default; the toggle reflects it) |
| `data-collapsible` | boolean |  | show the collapse toggle |
| `data-description` | text |  | secondary text (rendered into .description) |
| `data-dismissible` | boolean |  | show the close button |
| `data-draggable` | boolean |  | show the drag handle |
| `data-heading` | text |  | heading text (rendered into .title) |
| `data-icon` | text |  | a glyph before the title (shows the icon slot) |
| `data-type` | `default` `panel` | `default` | default \| panel |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `header-dismiss` |  |
| `header-collapse` | `{ collapsed: boolean }` |
| `header-drag` |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `icon` | icon | custom icon element (else data-icon glyph) |
| `heading` | text | custom heading element (replaces the default .title) |
| `actions` | control, input | extra trailing action controls (before close) |
| `metadata` | content | bottom metadata strip (Panel) / secondary content (Default) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`actions`, `close`, `description`, `drag`, `header`, `icon`, `labels`, `left`, `metadata`, `title`, `toggle`
